description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pelena, Weligama D/S Division, Mathara District - Cad. Map No. (7789)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title amendments and corrections to land parcel registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries amending land parcel numbers, extents (hectares), and owner name corrections for specific land parcels across various districts in Sri Lanka. The content falls squarely under Land Gazettes as it involves land registrations, property ownership details, and amendments to land title records.
